About the role:
As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda, and Camunda's own analytics product is bottlenecked by querying the same storage the live engine depends on. You'll be part of a greenfield team rebuilding how process data is consumed and served at scale, built on top of a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures.
At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs.
What You Will Do:
• 
Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.
• 
Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, object storage.
• 
Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.
• 
Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.
• 
Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.
What You Will Bring to the Role:
Must Haves:
• 
7+ years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on distributed or data-intensive systems.
• 
Hands-on experience building or operating an analytical serving layer over a table format such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake - including experience with an embedded/lightweight query engine (e.g. DuckDB, or similar), or a stateful stream-processing framework (e.g. Flink, Kafka Streams).
• 
A track record of working with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them.
• 
Solid grounding in the reasoning behind correctness and consistency in data-intensive systems (e.g. concurrent writes, atomicity, idempotency).
• 
A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.
• 
Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.
• 
Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.
Nice to Haves:
• 
Experience with Kafka or a similar streaming/event-log system
• 
Experience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads.
• 
Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing.
• 
Familiarity with object-storage-native streaming architectures (e.g. systems like WarpStream) is a plus, even without direct hands-on experience.

1dbe7e00f3927bd9.description: **About Dentira** Dentira is one of the fastest-growing, Series B, profitable healthcare technology companies, building the next generation infrastructure for clinic operations. We started by revolutionizing dental procurement with the world’s first real-time price and product comparison engine for dental supplies. Today, Dentira operates across the US, Canada, Asia Pacific, and Europe. Building on this foundation, our Lab Platform streamlines case creation and management by connecting clinics, intraoral scanners, and dental labs. We’re also applying AI to complex healthcare problems such as automatic invoice reconciliation, procedure cost prediction, and intelligent procurement, with solutions that have broad applicability across healthcare. As we expand into adjacent verticals, our goal is to achieve 10X growth over the next 3 years and be at the forefront of Agentic Commerce for healthcare supplies. Dentira just raised a $50M Series B from Vista Equity Partners, one of the world's leading technology-focused private equity firms and an investor behind landmark software transactions including the $16.5B acquisition of Citrix. **The Role** We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with 5+ years of experience building performant, scalable, and reliable systems at product companies and startups.You’ll work on challenging engineering problems spanning distributed systems, data-intensive platforms, event-driven architectures, APIs, AI-powered workflows, and high-scale backend infrastructure that directly power healthcare operations across multiple markets. This is a high-ownership role. You’ll take complex and often ambiguous problems from requirements and architecture through implementation, production deployment, observability, scaling, and incident resolution. We’re looking for someone with strong problem-solving fundamentals who can use the right abstractions to turn complex real-world problems into elegant, maintainable systems. You should be comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and influencing technical decisions beyond your immediate area of ownership. You should also be AI-native in how you engineer - comfortable using coding agents, LLM-powered development workflows,and agentic practices to accelerate implementation, debugging, testing, and system understanding. **Primary Requirements** * 5+ years of experience building and scaling backend services and microservices using Nodejs (with TypeScript) and Go. * Strong expertise in API design best practices across REST and GraphQL, with a solid understanding of HTTP fundamentals, API contracts, versioning, reliability, and performance. * Deep experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL and MongoDB, with expertise in database design, query optimization, indexing, and operating databases at scale. * Strong data modelling skills, with the ability to design schemas and domain models that remain maintainable as products and requirements evolve. * Strong ability to use abstractions effectively - designing clean interfaces, reusable components, and well-defined system boundaries without unnecessary complexity. * Strong hands-on experience with event-driven architectures and distributed systems, including message brokers such as RabbitMQ or Kafka, with the ability to design for scalability, resilience, consistency, and reliability. * Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, including deploying, operating, troubleshooting, and scaling production workloads. * Strong understanding of backend system performance, concurrency, caching, asynchronous processing, fault tolerance, observability, and production reliability. * End-to-end ownership of backend systems - from requirement clarification and architecture design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring, scaling, and incident resolution. * Solid foundation in data structures and algorithms, coupled with strong debugging and troubleshooting skills. * Experience mentoring engineers, conducting thoughtful code and architecture reviews, and influencing engineering standards and technical best practices. * An AI-native engineering mindset, with demonstrated ability to effectively use coding agents and agentic development practices to accelerate development, debugging, testing, and problem-solving. **Good to Have** * Experience designing or operating LLM-powered production systems, especially where correctness matters * Worked with agent orchestration frameworks, or with MCP and the surrounding ecosystem * Open-source contributions or meaningful participation in developer communities.
